name: CrossEarth-Benchmark
description: CrossEarth-Benchmark evaluates model performance and robustness on Earth observation (satellite/aerial) imagery across different geographic regions and domain shifts. It measures tasks such as land-cover classification and segmentation under domain variability and aims to benchmark cross-domain generalization for remote sensing models. The benchmark emphasizes evaluation across diverse sensors, resolutions, and environmental conditions.
reputation: Targeted at the remote sensing community; used for domain-generalization research but not yet a broadly established standard.
